name: diagonal corridor
comment: Two triangular rooms joined only by a narrow corridor (0.6 m, the robot is 0.4 m) along the room's diagonal: a 1 m door from the bottom-right room at the corridor's bottom end, one into the upper-left room at its top end. On a grid the corridor's walls are staircases: at cells up to 0.2 m it is open, at 0.25 m it opens and closes with a shift of the grid, and from 0.3 m it is closed. Rotate the grid 45 degrees and the corridor is aligned with it.
